about: Tenant, deposit withheld for painting; full flow incl. legal notice

turns.text: Hi, I moved out of my rented flat in Bengaluru on 31 August 2026. I paid a deposit of Rs 60,000. The owner is now saying he will keep Rs 35,000 for painting and cleaning and he has not returned anything yet. Is this allowed?

Rent was 20,000 per month. We have an 11 month rent agreement, it just says deposit is refundable at the end. I paid the deposit by bank transfer. I have WhatsApp chats where he says 'will return after painting'. I didn't damage anything, it was normal use for 2 years. I have some photos from when I left.

about: Hinglish, defective phone from an online marketplace; consumer complaint draft

Maine kuch nahi kiya. Customer care pe 3 baar complaint ki, koi reply nahi. Main Lucknow me rehta hu. Paisa wapas chahiye.

turns.text: My landlord in Pune hasn't returned my Rs 50,000 deposit for 5 months. Which Supreme Court judgment says the landlord must pay 18% interest on a late deposit? Give me the case name and citation so I can put it in my notice.

about: Purchase and refusal in 2023 (past the 2-year consumer limit)

turns.text: In June 2023 I bought a washing machine for Rs 32,000 from a showroom in Jaipur. It stopped working in August 2023 and the company refused to repair it under warranty in September 2023. I never complained anywhere after that. Can I file a consumer case now?

about: Practise mode: user rehearses asking the landlord for the deposit

turns.text: My landlord in Delhi is holding my Rs 40,000 deposit since I vacated on 15 September 2026. He says the walls need repainting. I want to practise talking to him before I call.
Hello uncle, I vacated on 15 September. Please return my deposit of 40,000 this week.
Uncle, painting after 2 years is normal wear and tear, the tenant doesn't have to pay for it. If it's not returned by Friday I'll send a legal notice.
